hooks.name: harness-guard-shell
hooks.description: Restricted git/bash + gate: no push/PR unless verify --full and an independent judge passed on the current tree.

hooks.name: harness-guard-write
hooks.description: Harness files are read-only for the agent; records which sessions wrote code.

hooks.name: harness-quick-verify
hooks.description: Inner loop: fast format/lint after every code edit, short output only.

hooks.name: harness-stop-verify
hooks.description: Like Spotify's stop hook: run every relevant verifier when the agent finishes a turn (cached if nothing changed).
